openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The GL-MT6000 (Flint 2) router is based on the MediaTek Filogic 830 with dual-band 4x4 Wi-Fi 6, two 2.5Gbit WAN, four 1Gbit LAN, 1GB DDR4 RAM, 8GB eMMC storage, and USB 3.2.
openwrt_wiki.hardware_highlights: The Filogic 830 SoC has a 2.0GHz 4core Arm Cortex-A53 and network processing engine (NPU) manufactured on 12nm lithography.
openwrt_wiki.installation: Always flash a sysupgrade image (OEM web UI 192.168.8.1 or U-Boot web UI 192.168.1.1 after holding Reset ~10 s while powering on). Do not use a factory image.
openwrt_wiki.recovery: Reset während des Betriebs ~8 s halten -> LED blinkt schnell -> Overlay-Reset; Failsafe: LED blinkt 10-15 s nach Einschalten schnell
openwrt_wiki.return_to_oem: OEM-Firmware ist OpenWrt-Fork, sysupgrade-kompatibel; Zweige Kernel 5.4 (MTK SDK) und Kernel 6.6 (mt76)
openwrt_wiki.leds: eine LED vorne, blau oder weiß; blue:run, white:system
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout: mmcblk0 7.3G, p1 512K, p2-p5 je 2M, p6 32M, p7 7.2G (rootfs); mmcblk0boot0/1 je 4M; tmpfs 493.3M
openwrt_wiki.switch: MT7531AE switch & 5x GBit PHY an eth0 (Ports 0-3 = lan2-lan5, Port 5 = lan1 über RTL8221B); WAN eth1 über RTL8221B direkt an CPU
openwrt_wiki.serial: The pins are unpopulated, but clearly labeled and accessible without removing the heatsink.
openwrt_wiki.jtag: Like the serial pins, they are unpopulated, but clearly labeled and accessible without removing the heatsink.
openwrt_wiki.foto_seriell_beschriftung: TCK RTCK TDO SYSRST GND | VCC TRST TDI TMS | GND TX RX VCC, J1
openwrt_wiki.benchmarks: WAN-LAN SFO+HFO 958/36 Mbit/s; SQM cake 885/20; WLAN 5 GHz 80 MHz 750-810 Mbit/s; WireGuard 806 Mbit/s (Kernel 5.15), ~750 (6.6/6.12)
openwrt_wiki.leistungsaufnahme: Generally this is said to be an 8-10W device. https://www.tpcdb.com/product.php?id=7698
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse: two wall mount slots; Dimensions 233 x 137 x 53mm; Weight 761g; 4 phillips screws under 4 rubber feet; clips; giant heatsink; 2 screws on top; 8 antenna cables; backplate with 4 screws; thermal pads both sides; RF shields
openwrt_wiki.iw_list: Available Antennas TX 0xf RX 0xf; Beispiel-Regdomain mit 2.4 GHz 30 dBm, 5 GHz 23/24 dBm (nicht EU)
openwrt_wiki.notes: Power cable relatively short 3ft (1m); USB port located on the side
